mapper.sql: o.event_id AS eventId, o.topic AS topic, o.event_key AS eventKey, o.body AS body, o.state AS state, o.publish_attempt AS publishAttempt, o.next_run_at AS nextRunAt, o.claim_token AS claimToken, o.claim_until AS claimUntil, o.published_at AS publishedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbox_event (event_id, topic, event_key, body, state, publish_attempt, next_run_at, created_at) VALUES (#{o.eventId}, #{o.topic}, #{o.eventKey}, CAST(#{o.body} AS JSON), 'PENDING', 0, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM outbox_event o WHERE o.state = 'PENDING' AND o.next_run_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY o.next_run_at ASC, o.event_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET state = 'CLAIMED', claim_token = #{claimToken}, claim_until = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{claimSeconds} SECOND), publish_attempt = publish_attempt + 1 WHERE state = 'PENDING' AND next_run_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND event_id IN #{id}
UPDATE outbox_event SET state = 'PUBLISHED', published_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), claim_token = NULL, claim_until = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND claim_token = #{claimToken} AND state = 'CLAIMED'

UPDATE outbox_event SET state = 'PENDING', next_run_at = DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{delayMillis} MICROSECOND), claim_token = NULL, claim_until = NULL WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND claim_token = #{claimToken} AND state = 'CLAIMED'
UPDATE outbox_event SET state = 'PENDING', claim_token = NULL, claim_until = NULL WHERE state = 'CLAIMED' AND claim_until < UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM outbox_event o WHERE o.event_id = #{eventId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox_event WHERE state <> 'PUBLISHED'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO inbox_event (consumer_group, event_id, body_hash, processed_at) VALUES (#{consumerGroup}, #{eventId}, #{bodyHash}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT body_hash FROM inbox_event WHERE consumer_group = #{consumerGroup} AND event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO poison_message (topic, partition_id, offset_id, error_code, body_hash, created_at) VALUES (#{topic}, #{partitionId}, #{offsetId}, #{errorCode}, #{bodyHash}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM poison_message WHERE topic = #{topic} AND partition_id = #{partitionId} AND offset_id = #{offsetId}
